meta.description: Character pose definitions for multi-pose generation via IPAdapter

idle.label: Idle
idle.prompt_suffix: standing relaxed, neutral pose, weight on one leg, calm expression, ready stance

attack.label: Attack
attack.prompt_suffix: aggressive attack pose, striking forward, dynamic action pose, motion blur on weapon, intense expression, mid-swing

hit.label: Hit Reaction
hit.prompt_suffix: recoiling from impact, pain expression, knocked back, defensive flinch, taking damage, off-balance

block.label: Block / Defend
block.prompt_suffix: defensive stance, arms raised blocking, bracing for impact, shield up, guarding pose, protective posture

cast.label: Cast / Channel
cast.prompt_suffix: channeling energy, hands glowing with power, magical casting pose, energy gathering around hands, focused concentration, arcane gesture

death.label: Death / Defeated
death.prompt_suffix: collapsing, falling backward, defeated pose, fading away, dissolving, losing consciousness, crumpling to ground

victory.label: Victory
victory.prompt_suffix: triumphant pose, weapon raised high, victorious stance, confident expression, celebrating

netrunner.attack: slashing with holographic data blade, cyan energy trail, fast precise strike, assassin-like lunge
netrunner.cast: both hands raised typing in air, holographic screens appearing, hacking gesture, data streams flowing from fingertips
netrunner.block: deploying holographic firewall shield, crouching behind data barrier, cyan defensive grid
netrunner.death: glitching and pixelating, digital dissolution, fragmenting into data particles

sysadmin.attack: shield bash forward, heavy armored charge, green energy shockwave from shield, powerful slam
sysadmin.cast: deploying shield drones, hexagonal barriers expanding outward, fortifying pose, green energy dome forming
sysadmin.block: massive shield raised, hexagonal barrier fully deployed, immovable stance, green energy wall
sysadmin.death: armor cracking and falling apart, shield drones sparking and crashing, heavy collapse

cryptomancer.attack: hurling purple cipher orb, arcane projectile launch, runes spiraling outward from hands, magical blast
cryptomancer.cast: floating in air, surrounded by spinning cipher rings, deep meditation, purple mandala expanding, eyes glowing
cryptomancer.block: cipher shield mandala spinning in front, runic barrier, sacred geometry defense grid
cryptomancer.death: cipher fragments scattering, robe collapsing empty, dissolving into purple mist and rune fragments

white_hat.attack: precise holographic blade thrust, surgical strike, golden data lance, calculated attack

white_hat.death: halo ring shattering, coat tearing, data monocle cracking, clean collapse

technomancer.death: reality snapping back, void imploding, daemons scattering, consumed by own void energy
